metadata.title: Causal Couture Week 10 — Reliability Reconciliation — Short
metadata.continuity: Portrait-native derivative of the approved Week 10 master; not a crop.
metadata.methodological_boundary: The reliability review interprets existing diagnostics; it is not a causal estimator, replacement, score, or source of causal proof.
metadata.production_gate: Direct clean-master production authorized after internal QC; no review/slate export.

beats.narration_text: Hi, my name is Ushasvi Rachel, and this video is about reliability reconciliation and evidence interpretation in Causal Couture. Week 10 asks how Phase 5 diagnostics should be interpreted together.

shot.visual_intent: Integrated presenter introduction and Week 10 transition.

beats.narration_text: Phase 5 includes estimation, bootstrap uncertainty, placebos, temporal falsification, overlap, stockout, robustness, and confounding sensitivity. Week 10 adds no estimator. It reviews them collectively.

shot.visual_intent: Full-height diagnostic stack converging into the Week 10 question.

beats.narration_text: The new module is causal_reliability_review.py. It is not an estimator, replacement, or causal proof. It organizes diagnostic availability, limitations, sensitivity findings, and areas needing investigation.

The review labels diagnostics successful, inconclusive, or failed. These mean usable results, insufficient analytical evidence, or processing errors. They describe availability, not support for the primary estimate.

shot.visual_intent: Stacked successful, inconclusive, and failed status cards.

beats.narration_text: Unavailable or inconclusive is not evidence for or against the effect. Possible causes include insufficient observations, treatment variation, inputs, analytical conditions, or execution errors. No specific Week 10 failure is claimed.

shot.visual_intent: Unavailable-not-evidence cards and possible status conditions.

beats.narration_text: Week 9 sensitivity findings enter the review. Directional stability is reassuring only within tested synthetic conditions. A direction change suggests sensitivity to modeled assumptions. Neither outcome proves causality or reveals a real confounder.

shot.visual_intent: Four stress scenarios with conservative two-path interpretation.

beats.narration_text: The estimator asks what effect the model estimates. The review asks how much caution should surround it. Causal intelligence now includes reliability_review, also exposed by GET slash phase five slash causal reliability review.

Bootstrap addresses uncertainty; cluster bootstrap, repeated-SKU uncertainty; shuffled placebo, destroyed treatment structure; temporal placebo, an impossible direction; overlap, treatment variation; stockout, inventory distortion; robustness, specification sensitivity; and confounding sensitivity, hypothetical omitted-variable pressure.

Multiple successful diagnostics do not establish causal identification. Observational evidence, methodological robustness, and a proven causal effect are not equivalent. The review keeps those boundaries visible.
Week 10 unifies estimate, evidence, reliability, and interpretation. A model producing an estimate is not the same as having sufficiently reliable evidence for a strong causal interpretation.

shot.visual_intent: Vertical estimate-to-interpretation progression and central takeaway.
